control_accounting: Control state and any current COMMIT are separate from business preservation. Complete serialized business/control descriptors, exact projections, all roots/entries/bytes/time and absence rows remain bound in the one epoch observation. Empty present-control domain is explicit None.
control_leaf_accounting: Every flat original transfer leaf is one global root/object and entry with all bytes/time charged. Exact pinned UID2000/0666 incoming originals are a specific path+full9+bytes/hash exception; generic nonfixture files remain root0/0600. Fixed leaves stay exclusively in epoch_observation.control_leaves, never in a v1 directory-root inventory. Parent names/full9 are observed twice, no parent subtree is claimed.
control_leaf_proof: epoch_observation.control_leaves is ordered [{path,entry: original full file row or explicit allowed ENOENT}]; control_leaf_parent_observations records each exact parent initial/final metadata+names and first/last elapsed in the one clock. New active transfer material must reside in explicitly reviewed control subtrees, not arbitrary new flat leaf templates.
nonfixture_absence: Explicit required absent retained/control roots are charged to global root and entry budgets and retained only in epoch_observation.absence_observations; they never enter either original v1 inventory view.
not_proved_here: cross-operation preservation or exact allowed shared additions
any physical NEG14 or target case result
positive_absence_original: Each fixture or nonfixture root actual ENOENT has independent canonical-parent initial/final full9, two held + one reopened initial checks, one global reopened check and first/last elapsed inside the one operation clock. None are invented from spec alone.

public_functions.inventory_epoch: (spec) -> {inventory: business+present-retained original complete-inventory.v1, control_inventory: present-control complete-inventory.v1 or None, epoch_observation}; single internal union traversal/budget then projections
public_functions.inventory_epoch_spec_value: (spec) -> exact roots, fixture_roots, required_absence_roots, alias_pairs, active_reservation_count, active_fixture_count, business_inventory_roots, control_inventory_roots, control_leaf_paths, control_leaf_pins, domain_roots, spec_sha256; pure structural union validation; adds exact retained_failed_fixture_absences and retained_failed_fixture_absence_roots
public_functions.verify_epoch_inventory_observation: (spec, inventory, control_inventory, observation) -> hepta.native-guard.two-epoch-inventory-verification.v2; pure structural proof, never original-provenance/cross-operation preservation qualification

value_shape.absence_roots: explicit subset of extra paths permitted to have requested positive ENOENT
value_shape.alias_pairs: explicit fixed retained complete per-leaf pair list
value_shape.control_leaves: ordered exact4 descriptors {path,bytes,sha256,metadata}; all full9 must be known before source binding; no future wildcard phase leaves

serialization: Inventory descriptor bytes are component_common.encoded(value): UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=False, trailing LF. None control has descriptor None, never fabricated empty v1.

active_reservations.identity: None before actual IDENTITY or exact {label,nonce}
active_reservations.inventory_roots: exact ordered subset of [Android journal, GNU home, UID2000 fixture], derived by late from actual phase originals, never self-selected
active_reservations.ordinal: consecutive int1..N <=8, every consumed reservation retained

spec.alias_pairs: lex-sorted list of sorted two-element exact path lists, <=15000; old55 plus fixed retained aliases mandatory, active aliases only same-relative GNU home/executor <-> exact Android journal; each view fully charged

control_leaves.path: exact source-bound retained flat transfer leaf path
control_leaves.presence: present|absent; absence only for explicitly allowed fixed path

control_roots.presence: present|absent; absence only for explicitly allowed fixed path

retained_roots.presence: present|absent; absence only for explicitly allowed fixed path

time_semantics: single cooperative observation clock including spec validation/traversal/bookends/pure proof; no timer or signal can interrupt a blocking kernel call
